ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 45% high-intensity white pixels localized to the lateral lobes versus 55% low-intensity black pixels concentrated in the central axial region and trailing edge margins.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-intensity white blobs occupy the distal two-thirds of both the left and right lobes. These are bordered by low-intensity black contiguous regions at the peduncle insertion and along the entire trailing edge boundary, with dense speckling (mottling) at the transition zones.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 65 degrees and a high depth-to-width ratio relative to the fluke span.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude serrations (jagged peaks) distributed continuously along the trailing edge of both lobes, ranging from 5 to 20 pixels in height from the baseline contour.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature originating from the median notch transitioning to a convex sweep toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Visible dark, roughly circular pixel clusters located on the distal white tip of the right lobe and scattered along the upper margin of the left lobe white region.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple high-contrast vertical linear pixel disruptions (white on black) visible on the central axial region near the water line.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent vertical rake marks on the central peduncle area and significant irregular tissue loss/jaggedness at the extreme distal tips of both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique 'Y' shaped white scar pattern located centrally just above the peduncle water line.
